log: Enemy necromancer used grave bolt for 3 damage.
Enemy skeleton used rust blade for 3 damage and took 3 in retaliation.
Enemy bone archer used bone bow for 2 damage and took 2 in retaliation.
Your great boar used tusks for 6 damage.

dialogue.speaker: Tamsin
dialogue.text: I came from the villages to help you reach the council. The workers were our neighbors. Dain cannot speak; their families must hear this branch.

dialogue.speaker: Lark
dialogue.text: The Rootbinder wants his bargain kept hidden. The branch and the ledger must reach the northern village.

dialogue.speaker: Alder
dialogue.text: Take the bridge fort and protect Lark. We owe the families an open road and an honest account, including Dain’s death.

dialogue.speaker: Lark
dialogue.text: The old crossing post has provisions for a stranded escort. Bring another shield to the road; the families are waiting on the other bank.

dialogue.speaker: Lark
dialogue.text: The families heard the workers’ memories. We told them about Dain too. The council has revoked the Overseer’s charter.

dialogue.speaker: Alder
dialogue.text: The fort is ours. The households will help us guard the crossing and keep the sacred groves outside their timber cutting.

dialogue.speaker: Lark
dialogue.text: Then let the first travelers cross. We have enough graves; we need neighbors.

dialogue.speaker: Lark
dialogue.text: The first cart crossed today. It carried apples, not axes.

dialogue.speaker: Alder
dialogue.text: Keep the road open. The roots will do the rest.

campaign.outcome: Mission complete. The company can rest and regroup.

dialogue.speaker: Lark
dialogue.text: The council promised the villages repair timber. Its Overseer marked our sacred groves instead. His crews keep their tools and carts in those two forts.

dialogue.speaker: Alder
dialogue.text: Take the camps and the cutting stops. The northern post kept the workers’ records. Bring those back too.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Dain
dialogue.text: My missing woodcutters were sent here. The Overseer says your pack killed them. I have orders to protect the crews that remain.

dialogue.speaker: Lark
dialogue.text: Your orders won’t tell us where they went. Their ledger might.

dialogue.speaker: Alder
dialogue.text: We need our roots back, not your bones. Keep away from our groves, captain, and help us find your people.

dialogue.text: The captain is dead. Destroy that branch before the council hears a word of this.

dialogue.speaker: Lark
dialogue.text: The workers demanded their wages and refused to cut the grove. The Overseer delivered them to the Rootbinder; he killed and bound them into his logging crews.

dialogue.speaker: Alder
dialogue.text: Dain is among the dead now too. We cannot undo that. Bring the branch and the ledger to the families, and let them judge the whole account.
